title: olearia phlogopappa subsp. angustifolia
intro: Olearia phlogopappa subsp. angustifolia, commonly known as a species of flowering shrub, is a plant native to Australia and is recognized for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Olearia phlogopappa subsp. angustifolia include its potential to reduce inflammation and alleviate symptoms associated with anxiety and depression. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, that have been shown to possess antioxidant and antimicrobial properties. Further research is necessary to fully understand the bioactive constituents and potential therapeutic applications of Olearia phlogopappa subsp. angustifolia.
